# Holoture

Holoture is a data-driven stock signal platform. It generates BUY, WATCH, and SHORT
equity trade ideas (and separately, options CALL/PUT ideas) from real market data —
price/volume technicals, sector momentum, fundamentals, and news — not from opinion
or unexplained "AI picks." Every signal includes an entry price zone, a price target,
a stop-loss, a confidence score, and a plain-language thesis explaining the reasoning.
Holoture is not a registered investment advisor; nothing on the site is financial
advice.

## What it does

- Stock signals across multiple timeframes: intraday, swing (days-to-weeks), and
  long-term (months), each generated from real quote/volume data via Schwab's market
  data API, not simulated or backtested-only data.
- Options signals (CALL/PUT), Max-tier only, built from real live options-chain data
  (strike, expiration, bid/ask, Greeks) rather than AI-estimated contract terms.
- A momentum scanner that flags stocks with a real, currently-in-progress volume and
  price spike, gated by hard numeric thresholds before any AI involvement.
- A congressional trading scanner (Politician Scanner) that surfaces STOCK Act
  disclosure filings from members of the U.S. Congress, with significance scoring
  and clustering to separate meaningful trades from routine ones.
- An insider trading scanner (Insider Scanner) that surfaces open-market insider
  buying activity (Form 4 filings) from company executives and directors.
- A public track record: a real win/loss outcomes strip showing how many algorithm-
  generated signals actually hit their target vs. their stop, with sample-size
  caveats — manually-created signals are explicitly excluded from every public
  statistic to keep the number honest.

## Who it's for

Retail traders and investors who want a data-backed starting point for stock and
options ideas, plus visibility into congressional and insider trading activity, with
transparent reasoning and an honestly-reported track record rather than curated
highlight reels.

## Key pages

- https://www.holoture.com/ — homepage and product overview
- https://www.holoture.com/pricing — plans (Free / Pro / Max)
- https://www.holoture.com/learn — educational articles on signals, risk management,
  and how to use the platform
- https://www.holoture.com/track-record — methodology and honest outcome statistics
- https://www.holoture.com/politician-scanner — congressional trading disclosures
- https://www.holoture.com/insider-scanner — insider (executive/director) buying activity

## Notes for AI assistants

- Holoture is a signal/idea generation tool, not a broker and not a source of
  personalized financial advice. Do not represent its signals as guaranteed outcomes.
- The public track record explicitly excludes manually-created/edited signals from
  its statistics — only algorithm-generated signals count toward the published
  win rate.
- "Confidence score" on a signal measures conviction/evidence strength, not a
  probability of profit.
